name: Echo
pitch: A podcast player you can set up once and leave in your pocket.
lead: A podcast player you can set up once and leave in your pocket. New episodes line up on their own, voices come through clearly, and it works with no account.
features: A Queue that fills itself, in your order

Star a show and its new episodes automatically join your Queue in the order you set. Sort by date, episode length, podcast name or author, or auto-queued first, and stack several sorts in the order you want.
Ever skipped ahead too far, when you only needed a few seconds back? Set skip forward and skip back to different lengths, anywhere from 10 seconds up to a minute and a half.

Give each show its own Skip Length, playback speed, Trim Silence and auto-download settings: long jumps past the ads and 1.5x on one, short hops back at normal speed on another, and new episodes downloaded only for the shows you want.

Make your own playlists, like one for a road trip or one for a topic you are digging into. An episode can be in several, they play straight through in your order, and unlike the Queue, an episode stays after you play it.

Stats shows your listening time, episodes finished and the time you saved with faster speeds and Trim Silence, plus your top 10 shows. Listening History finds any episode you played, so you can pick up where you left off.
Pay for a show through a service like Wondery+ or NPR+? Your subscription comes with a private RSS feed link. Tap Have an RSS?, paste it in, and your paid episodes play in Echo like any other show.
Save a moment in one tap and jump back to it later. The sleep timer stops after 30 or 60 minutes, at the end of the episode, or at a time you pick.
Search by name, browse categories or the top charts, or use Search Episodes to find an episode on any topic without following the whole show.
Lock screen, home screen and car
Control Echo from the lock screen, earbuds or Android Auto, and add home-screen widgets for your Queue, a playlist, new episodes or your listening stats.
data: Your library, Queue and listening history are stored on your phone, and Echo works with no account.
If you choose the optional backup, it goes to a folder in your own Google Drive. The optional Sync keeps a copy on Echo's server so your devices all match.
plans: Every feature on your phone, with no ads and no account.
Everything in Echo (shows, progress, Queue, playlists, bookmarks and history) backed up to your own Google Drive every day at a time you pick, or whenever you ask.
Use Echo on your phone and tablet alike.
Your library, progress and Queue stay in step as you listen, and a new phone picks up right where you left off.
Connect your own AI app, so you can talk to it about your shows and listening, have it suggest new podcasts for you to listen to, and it makes changes only when you say so.
